title: Attention Is All You Need
significance: Introduced the Transformer architecture based entirely on self-attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions, forming the universal backbone of modern generative AI.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
significance: Introduced residual skip connections (identity shortcut mappings), overcoming the vanishing/exploding gradient barrier and enabling training of networks over 100-1000 layers deep.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
significance: Pioneered masked language modeling (MLM) and bidirectional representations with fine-tuning, revolutionizing natural language understanding benchmarks.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
significance: Demonstrated that scaling autoregressive language models to 175B parameters produces strong in-context few-shot capabilities without gradient updates or fine-tuning.

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
significance: Formulated a tractable connection between score matching, Langevin dynamics, and variational inference in diffusion models, unlocking modern photorealistic generative AI.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale (ViT)
significance: Demonstrated that standard Transformer encoders applied directly to linear projections of flattened image patches achieve SOTA performance on vision tasks, replacing inductive spatial convolutions when pre-trained on sufficient data.
core_equations: z_0 = [x_{\text{class}}; x_p^1 E; \dots; x_p^N E] + E_{\text{pos}}

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (InstructGPT)
significance: Pioneered the modern 3-step alignment workflow (Supervised Fine-Tuning, Reward Modeling, and PPO Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), resolving the alignment tax.
core_equations: \text{obj}(\phi) = \mathbb{E}_{(x, y) \sim D_{\pi_{\phi}^{\text{RL}}}} \left[r_\theta(x, y) - \beta D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_\phi^{\text{RL}}(y \mid x) \parallel \pi^{\text{SFT}}(y \mid x))\right]

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
significance: Hypothesized that weight updates in LLMs possess low 'intrinsic rank', decomposing Delta W into low-rank matrices B x A (r << d), slashing trainable parameters by 10,000x and GPU VRAM requirements by 3x.
core_equations: h = W_0 x + \frac{\alpha}{r} B A x

title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
significance: Established empirical power-law relationships between cross-entropy loss and three fundamental axes: compute budget C, dataset size D, and parameter count N.
core_equations: L(N) = (N_c / N)^{\alpha_N}, \quad L(D) = (D_c / D)^{\alpha_D}, \quad L(C) = (C_c / C)^{\alpha_C}

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
significance: Re-architected exact self-attention around GPU memory hierarchy (HBM vs SRAM). By tiling inputs, fusing operations, and computing online softmax, delivered 2-4x wall-clock speedups.

title: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
significance: Replaced discrete layer stacks with continuous-depth neural ODEs, using the adjoint sensitivity method to train with O(1) memory and adaptive computation.

title: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Finding Sparse, Trainable Neural Networks
significance: Discovered that dense random networks contain sparse winning tickets that can train in isolation from initialization to match full network accuracy.
core_equations: m \odot \theta_0 \quad \text{(Iterative Magnitude Pruning with weight rewinding)}

title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks (DenseNet)
significance: Connected all layers directly via channel-wise concatenation, maximizing feature reuse, deep supervision, and parameter efficiency.

title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
significance: Constructed hierarchical vision representations with linear computational complexity using Shifted Window self-attention (SW-MSA).

title: Are Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models a Mirage?
significance: Proved that sharp emergent capability jumps in LLMs are mathematical mirages produced by non-linear threshold metrics rather than discrete model state changes.

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
significance: Derived the exact closed-form solution to the RLHF objective, replacing complex PPO actor-critic training with a simple cross-entropy loss directly on policy weights.
